label: Blocked mid-drain
description: The first slice hits a real blocker; the classified edge derives blocked and the drain stops for operator attention.
scenario: Round 1 cannot complete its slice comprehensively: a required upstream API contract is missing. The handoff records the blocker and the true frontier, and the loop stops instead of skipping ahead.

handoff.frontier: Plan phase 1: blocked on the upstream API contract.
